messages:
ellie: Heads-up — planning header-split + router rollout in tonight's quiet window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Need cross-service pin and deploybot sync. API/runtime/console owners, pls ack.
sam: acked. I'll take API side and pin v3.7.2 -> keep fallback v3.6.9.
miguel: runtime here. KV eviction heatmap looked ok on canary. We'll keep kernel batching off for first 10m. :thumbsup: 
lisa: console: can take the pin but want to validate the release notes include the deprecation note for old metrics endpoint. Also canary UX check 01:30 UTC?
ellie: @lisa yes please. canary UX at 01:30 is fine. rollback trigger: any >10% error rate increase on 5m rolling and >20% latency p95 regression vs baseline.
sam: what's the exact pin command so deploybot can do the handoff?
ellie: use:
```
redwoodctl pin --service api --version 3.7.2 --until 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z
redwoodctl pin --service console --version 2.5.1
```
miguel: runtime note: we'll set `--kernel-batching=false` and `--kv-ttl=120s` for the first wave. If memory climbs >85% on any shard, auto-unpin.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled: header-split toggle at 02:10 UTC. Canary slice: 5% -> 25% over 8m -> 100% at 30m. Auto-rollback on 'error_rate>10% for 5m' or 'p95_latency>baseline*1.2 for 10m'.
release-bot: release-bot: added release notes link: https://confluence.redwood/release/3.7.2 - please confirm completeness.
ellie: quick check — does router need any header whitelist updates? @sam @miguel
sam: router header whitelist already contains `x-rdwd-session` but we'll add `x-deploy-tag` to help tracing during canary.
miguel: runtime will accept `x-deploy-tag` but will strip on responses. logging flag `deploy_tag=true` set in canary.
lisa: added the metrics deprecation blurb and the console screenshots. :eyes: 
sam: ok pinning now and notifying deploybot.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pins applied: api=3.7.2 console=2.5.1 runtime=4.1.0-canary. Canary rollout scheduled. :rocket: 
ellie: thanks — I'll monitor traces and hand off to oncall at 02:40 for full wave. If anyone sees anything odd ping here and tag @oncall.
miguel: monitoring hooks in place, kv eviction thresholds set. Will 👍 if stable at 02:25.
sam: all green at 02:25 in canary slice. moving to 25%.
ellie: 02:40 handoff to oncall done. leaving notes in incident doc.
release-bot: release-bot: changelog published, bake window complete.
ellie: closing thread — keep followups in #incidents if rollback happens.
